# Weave.js

> Weave.js is a visual collaborative apps framework: a headless, store-agnostic SDK plus React helpers for building real-time collaborative canvases.

## Weave.js

- [Home](/weavejs/prerelease/): Weave.js — the framework for building visual collaborative applications.
- [Home](/weavejs/5.2.1/): Weave.js — the framework for building visual collaborative applications.

- [v3.0.0](/weavejs/prerelease/main/release-notes/3.0.0/): Focus on **performance, architecture flexibility, and cleaner integration APIs**.
- [v4.0.0](/weavejs/prerelease/main/release-notes/4.0.0/): Focus on unified snapping architecture and custom canvas guides.
- [v5.0.0](/weavejs/prerelease/main/release-notes/5.0.0/): Focus on **diagramming capabilities, optimistic persistence, and a cleaner store architecture**.

- [Align Nodes Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/align-nodes-tool/): Select nodes and align among them
- [Arrow Tool (deprecated)](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/arrow-tool/): Add an arrow to the canvas
- [Brush Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/brush-tool/): Paint freeform strokes on the canvas
- [Comment Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/comment-tool/): Allow users to comment on top of the stage content.

- [Ellipse Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/ellipse-tool/): Add an ellipse to the canvas
- [Eraser Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/eraser-tool/): Activate the deletion of nodes from the canvas
- [Export Node Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/export-node-tool/): Export the selected node as an image
- [Export Stage Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/export-stage-tool/): Export the entire stage (all nodes) node as an image
- [Fit to Screen Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/fit-to-screen-tool/): Set the zoom level so all the nodes on the stage are entirely visible on the screen
- [Fit to Selection Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/fit-to-selection-tool/): Set the zoom level so all the selected nodes are entirely visible on the screen
- [Frame Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/frame-tool/): Allows to add a canvas in canvas area
- [Image Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/image-tool/): Add an image to the canvas

- [Actions](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/): Actions maintained by Weave.js team
- [Line Tool (deprecated)](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/line-tool/): Add a simple line to the canvas

- [Move Tool](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/actions/move-tool/): Activate the panning or movement of the canvas

- [Stage Panning](/weavejs/prerelease/main/build/plugins/stage-panning/): Activates the panning (move) of the stage

- [WeaveArrowToolAction (deprecated)](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/arrow-tool/): Add line segments to the canvas
- [WeaveBrushToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/brush-tool/): Paint freeform strokes on the canvas
- [WeaveCommentToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/comment-tool/): Let users add comments to a (x,y) position of the stage.
- [WeaveConnectorToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/connector-tool/): Add connector nodes to the canvas
- [WeaveEllipseToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/ellipse-tool/): Add an ellipse to the canvas
- [WeaveEraserToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/eraser-tool/): Activate the deletion of nodes from the canvas
- [WeaveExportNodesToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/export-nodes-tool/): Export the selected nodes as an image
- [WeaveExportStageToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/export-stage-tool/): Tool to export the stage as an image
- [WeaveFitToScreenToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/fit-to-screen-tool/): Set the zoom level so all the nodes on the stage are entirely visible on the screen
- [WeaveFitToSelectionToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/fit-to-selection-tool/): Set the zoom level so all the selected nodes are entirely visible on the screen
- [WeaveFrameToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/frame-tool/): Allows to add a canvas in canvas area
- [WeaveImageToolAction](/weavejs/prerelease/sdk/api-reference/actions/image-tool/): Add an image to the canvas
